answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 52 identities per epoch. Audits are logged in tundra, queued in horizon, and quill publishes the wait time. A farm of 159 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1095 identities would post 2017 proofs and burn roughly 57 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
